nodes.idea: BASELINE: digit DP without leading_zero; leading zeros are multiplied into the product
CONTROL: digit DP with leading_zero but discards overflow product; does not keep overflow for later zero
Use digit DP tracking (tight, lead, prod) where any product exceeding K is capped to K+1 as an overflow bucket so a later digit 0 can reset it to 0.
Compute digit products iteratively layer by layer across the digits of N using a frequency map of (tight, lead, product) states with overflow capped to K + 1.
Perform digit DP over prime-factor exponent tuples (e2, e3, e5, e7) for digits 1-9 with dedicated states for zero product and overflow beyond K.
Use digit DP memoizing on the digit index and accumulated product capped at K+1, leveraging the fact that any subsequent zero digit resets the product to 0 <= K.

Perform digit DP over the digits of N with memoization on the current digit position and accumulated digit product (capped at K + 1), treating leading zeros separately and resetting the product to 0 upon encountering any non-leading zero.
Digit DP over the decimal representation of N with memoization on (digit_index, product) where products exceeding K are collapsed into a single overflow state that can still transition to 0.
Iterative digit DP maintaining counts of digit products bounded by K plus an overflow state K+1, allowing subsequent zero digits to reset the product to zero.
Perform digit DP tracking the prime-factorized digit product with an overflow state that can still transition to zero on encountering a digit 0.
